title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 366 (Companies capable of being registered)

content.overview: For this Part, “company” includes any partnership firm, LLP, cooperative society, society or other business entity formed under any other law that applies for registration. Any such entity consisting of two or more members may register under this Act as unlimited, limited by shares or limited by guarantee, subject to the provisos (no re-registration of 1882/1913/1956 companies; limits on unlimited/guarantee registration; fixed capital for limited-by-shares; majority assent; special majority and guarantee resolution where required). Registration is not invalid merely because it is with a view to winding up. A company with fewer than seven members registers as a private company.
content.glance: Partnerships, LLPs, societies and similar entities with 2+ members may register under the Act as unlimited, limited by shares or limited by guarantee, subject to statutory conditions and majority assent.
